title: Keto Kung Pao Chicken
description: A keto twist on the classic Chinese Sichuan dish, featuring crispy fried chicken and a spicy sauce.

ingredients.name: glowing hot sauce
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a low-carb hot sauce

instructions: 1. Cut the chicken breast into small pieces and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and crispy, about 5-6 minutes.
4. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
6. Add the garlic and green onions to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
7. Add the tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Add the pao paste and glowing hot sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
10. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
